mcq.q: Complete: Mount Everest is the ___ mountain in the world.

o: A giraffe is taller than a camel.
A giraffe is tallest than a camel.

mcq.q: Which sentence compares THREE or more things?
o: The whale is the largest animal.
A car is faster than a bike.
A giraffe is taller than a camel.
mcq.why: Superlatives like 'the largest' compare many things.
